name: Web Listing Circle Connector
author: wlcteam

sections.description:
Web Listing Circle Connector is a powerful plugin for business owners, freelancers, and local service providers. Connect your site with Web Listing Circle to:
* Submit your business listing with one click
* Connect securely using your API key
* Display a “Proudly Listed” badge on your website
* Stay visible and increase SEO with local listing power
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/web-listing-circle-connector directory, or install via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Web Listing Circle to start submitting your listing and connecting your account.
sections.faq:
Is it free to list?

Yes, Web Listing Circle offers a free basic listing option.

Can I show the badge on my homepage?

Yes! Use the shortcode [wlc_badge] anywhere on your site.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release with listing submission, API key support, and badge display.
